agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report and Financial Statements audited by PwC Indonesia and granted discharge to the Board of Directors and Commissioners.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved the allocation of the 2025 net profit of Rp57,537,287,243,071, including a total cash dividend of Rp336 per share and the designation of remaining funds as retained earnings.
Agenda #3: Shareholders authorized the Board of Commissioners and PT DWIMURIA INVESTAMA ANDALAN to determine the 2026 remuneration and 2025 bonuses for the Board of Directors and Commissioners.
Agenda #4: PwC Indonesia and Eddy Rintis were appointed to audit the company's 2026 financial records, with the Board of Commissioners authorized to appoint replacements and determine honorariums.
Agenda #5: The meeting approved a share buyback plan with a maximum budget of Rp5,000,000,000,000 and authorized the Board of Directors to execute the process and determine pricing.
Agenda #6: Shareholders approved amendments to the Company's Articles of Association and authorized the Board of Directors to execute all necessary legal actions and notary deeds.
Agenda #7: The meeting confirmed the end of current board terms and appointed the Board of Commissioners and Directors for the 2026-2029 period, including Jahja Setiaatmadja as President Commissioner and David Formula as a new Director.
Agenda #8: The meeting held on March 12, 2026, was declared valid with an attendance of 87.5944% of total shares.
